name: Ozu Castle
description: Ozu Castle was rebuilt in 2004 with a four-story wooden keep reconstructed from Edo-period plans, using traditional techniques. The castle town of Ozu, with its narrow streets and old merchant houses, surrounds it.
notes: Keep admission ¥550; combine with the Ozu Castle town walking course.

ja.name: 大洲城
ja.description: 2004年、江戸期の図面から木造で復元された大洲城。肱川沿いの城下町とともに残る四国有数の城です。
ja.notes: 天守は大人550円。城下町の散策コースと合わせてどうぞ。
